text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you so bummed out?! Isn't 
this an insanely hype development?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Our record stands at zero apiece! Which 
means—we're evenly matched rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, it's a battle of who 
gets it first! Next time, let's both do 
our best~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
